BiblicalUsage: Oklah is food, meat, in the old sense of anything eaten. In Genesis 1:29 God gives every herb bearing seed and every tree for meat, and in Exodus 16:15 the manna is the bread the Lord has given them to eat.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the food God gives is the proof He provides, from the garden to the wilderness.
RelatedEvents: Manna and Quail in the Wilderness
